record_scope_reconstruction: Second Friendship Bridge at Mae Sai–Tachileik, Chiang Rai, with two distinct February2021 phases: broader cargo interruption and a brief Myanmar gate closure during protests. The first Mae Sai bridge and both Mae Sot bridges are different facilities.

source_checks.finding: Original Thansettakij names bridgeII opposite Ban San Phak Hi, Mae Sai, cargo suspension and later reopening context.
Original Matichon describes protesters moving from bridgeI to bridgeII and a five-to-ten-minute Myanmar gate shutdown on February21.
Field-study inventory distinguishes Mae SaiI and II, with customs at bridgeII operational from2008.
Named bridge outline over Sai River inspected.

sites.name: Mae Sai–Tachileik Second Friendship Bridge
sites.coordinate_method: Mean of unique vertices in fresh OSM named feature outline
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: Named Second Friendship Bridge over the Sai River. Thai Customs and IDE field-study sources distinguish the second Mae Sai bridge at San Phak Hi from the first bridge; Mae Sot bridges are a different border town.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Second Friendship Bridge at Mae Sai–Tachileik, Chiang Rai, with two distinct February2021 phases: broader cargo interruption and a brief Myanmar gate closure during protests. The first Mae Sai bridge and both Mae Sot bridges are different facilities.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification:
FU-COV-EAS-001-FU1: February 20 is a closed-state observation; exact reopening and overnight continuity remain unknown. Cargo passage at the same second bridge is directly reported from 06:30 on February 23, bounding the earlier interruption by then.

FU-COV-EAS-001-FU2: The February 21 closure lasted five to ten minutes around 11:00; no whole-day duration is inferred.

A separate February 22 strike-related cessation affected cargo operators and warehouses. Keep it separate from the earlier protest blockades and from the COVID passenger restrictions.
